run_voice_agent: run the voice agent that connects to xAI realtime API through LiteLLM proxy and streams responses
run_main: run the main entry point that starts the LiveKit xAI voice agent with error handling
connect_realtime_api: connect to the xAI realtime API via WebSocket through the LiteLLM proxy server
stream_transcript: stream the response transcript deltas from the realtime API and print them in real time
review_run_voice_agent: review the run_voice_agent function that handles WebSocket connections and message streaming
